breakdown.description: The case is declared plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly provided the Lamé parameter formula for plane strain (`lambda = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu))`) while stating the problem was plane stress. The Agent repeated this exact incorrect formula in the generated specification, instead of correcting it to use the reduced plane-stress constitutive law as indicated by the ground truth.
